description.short: Afan Forest Park is one of Wales' premier mountain biking destinations, set within 14,000 acres of Afan Valley forest in Neath Port Talbot, South Wales. With trails for all abilities — from beginner green routes to the epic 46 km Skyline — plus walking, a visitor centre, bike hire, and café facilities at two hubs, it draws riders and walkers from across the UK.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified sources. Needs editorial review. The 14,000-acre figure should be verified — the Wikipedia article cites this but it is not directly confirmed on NRW or afanforestpark.com.
description.full:
Afan Forest Park, managed by Natural Resources Wales and Neath Port Talbot Council, is one of the UK's leading mountain biking destinations. Located in the Afan Valley near Cynonville, Port Talbot, the park spans thousands of acres of working Welsh forest crisscrossed by purpose-built trails.

Two visitor hubs provide the bases for exploration. The main Afan Argoed Visitor Centre (SA13 3HG) is the primary gateway, offering a visitor centre, café (Cedars Tearoom), the South Wales Miners Museum, bike hire (Afan Valley Bike Shed), bike wash, showers, toilets, and ample parking. The Glyncorrwg Mountain Bike Centre (SA13 3EA), approximately 10 miles north-east, adds a second base with its own café (Corrwg Cwtch), bike hire (Afan A Blast), and trails including the notorious Blade and the long-distance Skyline.

MTB trails span all grades from the beginner-friendly 6.1 km Rookie (green) to the 46 km, 2,000 m Skyline (red) and the 44 km W² black route linking two trail systems. Walking routes include riverside, ridgetop, and woodland paths. Cycling along the former Rhondda & Swansea Bay Railway corridor connects the two hubs. Mountain bike coaching is available through Campbell Coaching and Afan Valley Bike Shed. A Beamer Tramper mobility vehicle is available for hire for visitors with limited mobility.

Trail access is free; car parking is charged. Bike hire and coaching are bookable through third-party providers on site.
